canonical_branch.path_ordinal: base-3 digits in level order with the level-0 action most significant
canonical_branch.path_order: ascending path_ordinal; this is 0 < + < - and is not character-code order
canonical_branch.message_bit_order: bit index 0 is the most-significant bit of the UInt8 message
canonical_branch.required_recovery: strict affine decode must return exact status and the emitted message

index_domain.valid_state_order: ascending raw UInt16 among 0...511 after coordinate-9 parity validation

temporal_disabled_semantics.semantic_state: clear payload coordinate 7 in the source state and recompute coordinate 9 parity
temporal_disabled_semantics.affine_anchor: retain the original parity-valid raw source state without clearing coordinate 7
temporal_disabled_semantics.context_rule: contexts 1, 2, and 3 select the same messages, descriptors, weights, and parameter bytes as context 0 for the same phase and semantic state
temporal_disabled_semantics.parameter_rule: every temporal contribution flag and temporal mode byte is zero
temporal_disabled_semantics.runtime_rule: the spatial analyzer emits coordinate 7 as zero and never reads temporal history

source_aligned_exact_semantics.predicate: coordinate policy is source_aligned_rational and horizontal_index is 0 and vertical_index is 0
source_aligned_exact_semantics.compiler_order: enumerate, recover, and compatibility-check all 81 canonical leaves before applying the exact-source emission override
source_aligned_exact_semantics.parameter_slot: primary active and source-preservation flags set; all four semantic deltas, detail gain, and relaxed limiter alpha are zero; support radius is Keys base 512 Q8.8; temporal and denoising flags are zero
source_aligned_exact_semantics.reconstruction: return the exact source sample before operator adjustment

base_descriptor.kernel_bit: texture_high_frequency xor (edge_present and orientation_phase) xor phase_half_cycle
base_descriptor.detail_bit: edge_present and not alias_or_ringing_risk and texture_high_frequency

descriptor_application.kernel_bit: retain the base descriptor kernel bit for every semantic path; orientation delta never changes the kernel
descriptor_application.orientation_sector: add orientation_sector_delta modulo 4 to the continuous sidecar sector used by anisotropic reconstruction
descriptor_application.support_bit: retain the base descriptor isotropic/anisotropic support bit for every semantic path
descriptor_application.support_radius_q8_8: clamp(kernel base plus support_delta times selected support step, 256, 768), with Keys base 512 and Lanczos3 base 768
descriptor_application.detail_gain_q12: base is selected detail gain when base detail bit is one and zero otherwise; add detail_delta times selected detail step and clamp to [0,2048]
descriptor_application.detail_bit: one exactly when final detail_gain_q12 is positive
descriptor_application.relaxed_limiter_alpha_q12: base is selected alpha when base limiter bit is one and zero otherwise; subtract regularization_delta times selected regularization step and clamp to [0,1024]
descriptor_application.limiter_bit: one exactly when final relaxed_limiter_alpha_q12 is positive

semantic_steps.scale: one of four unoriented sectors modulo 4; never changes the base-kernel descriptor bit

candidate slot base is 512 Q8.8 for Keys or 768 Q8.8 for Lanczos3; add selected support_radius_step_q8_8 times the signed delta and saturating clamp to [256, 768]; the isotropic/anisotropic descriptor bit is unchanged
semantic_steps.storage: Int8 support_delta plus final UInt16 support_radius_q8_8

semantic_steps.scale: base is selected gain only when the base detail bit is one; add selected detail_gain_step_q12 times signed delta, clamp to [0,2048], and derive the resulting detail bit from final gain greater than zero
semantic_steps.storage: Int8 detail_delta plus final UInt16 detail_gain_q12

semantic_steps.scale: base is selected alpha only when the base limiter bit is one; positive subtracts and negative adds selected regularization_step_q12, clamp to [0,1024], and derive the resulting limiter bit from final alpha greater than zero
semantic_steps.storage: Int8 regularization_delta plus final UInt16 relaxed_limiter_alpha_q12

hard_compatibility: reject an anisotropic descriptor only when edge_present and coherent_structure are both zero
reject final detail gain greater than zero when alias_or_ringing_risk is one
reject final relaxed limiter alpha greater than zero when chroma_luma_structure_aligned is zero
reject a parameter outside its declared fixed-point range
source-aligned exact phases use the exact emission override and return the exact source sample; denoising is disabled
compiler failure is fatal when fewer than two compatible messages remain before confidence reduction

penalty.operand_binding: state predicates and base descriptor bits are evaluated from the temporal-cleared semantic state before path deltas; phase kernel uses the unchanged base kernel
terms: penalty_unsupported_support_expansion when support_delta is positive and base support predicate edge_present and coherent_structure is zero
penalty_coherent_support_reduction when support_delta is negative and base support predicate edge_present and coherent_structure is one
penalty_unsupported_detail_increase when detail_delta is positive and texture_high_frequency is zero
penalty_supported_detail_reduction when detail_delta is negative and base detail bit edge_present and texture_high_frequency and not alias_or_ringing_risk is one
penalty_relaxation_under_risk when regularization_delta is negative and either alias_or_ringing_risk is one or chroma_luma_structure_aligned is zero
penalty_phase_kernel_mismatch when kernel_bit differs from phase_half_cycle

mass_and_ranking.integer_rounding: for nonnegative integers numerator and denominator, round_half_up = (numerator + floor(denominator / 2)) / denominator using integer division
mass_and_ranking.leaf_mass_numerator: product of the four action mass numerators
mass_and_ranking.raw_message_mass: sum UInt64(leaf_mass_numerator * penalty_weight_unorm16) over every compatible path with that message; UInt64 overflow is fatal
mass_and_ranking.message_weight_q16_16: after the complete raw sum, compute numerator = raw_message_mass * 65536 with checked UInt64 multiplication, denominator = 256 * 65535, then round_half_up(numerator / denominator) exactly once and require the result to fit UInt32; zero is fatal; unit total mass encodes as 65536
mass_and_ranking.top_two: ranked messages at positions zero and one
mass_and_ranking.margin_unorm16: provisional_primary_weight_unorm16 - provisional_secondary_weight_unorm16, retained unchanged after confidence pruning
mass_and_ranking.confidence_rule: when margin_unorm16 is at least selected confidence_threshold_unorm16, emit the no-secondary sentinel and stored weights 65535 and zero while retaining provisional margin; otherwise emit both provisional weights

parameter_table.record_semantics: one record stores the primary and secondary representative parameters selected for one dispatch entry
parameter_table.inactive_secondary: all secondary slot bytes are zero when the no-secondary sentinel is emitted; an ordinary confidence-pruned entry retains its provisional top-two margin
parameter_table.ordering: deduplicate exact keys, then sort keys by unsigned bytewise lexicographic order
parameter_table.parameter_index: zero-based index in the sorted unique table
